classification_schema.BASE_BUNDLE_CANDIDATE: Small, stable, essential metadata. Include in initial app binary.
classification_schema.OPTIONAL_OFFLINE_PACKAGE: Useful offline but too large or optional for baseline. Offer as downloadable pack.
classification_schema.CACHE_AFTER_USE: Fetch on first use, cache locally. Do not bundle.
classification_schema.NETWORK_REQUIRED: Data is mutable, near-realtime, or legally restricted from offline use.
classification_schema.SERVER_ONLY: Backend/indexing artifacts not intended for client runtime.
classification_schema.NOT_ELIGIBLE: Cannot determine redistribution rights, or data is speculative.

datasets.rationale: EXACT crosswalk records (5 explicit) are stable reference metadata. PROBABLE records must ship with display constraints — not usable for navigation. Small payload; 1.6 KB gzip.
datasets.mobile_constraint: PROBABLE records must not enable first-mile walking navigation or distance calculations.

datasets.rationale: 5 corridor geometries provide map layer reference without live schedule dependency. Stable shapes; 1.4 KB gzip.
datasets.mobile_constraint: Display as approximate corridors only; not turn-by-turn routes.

datasets.rationale: High-simplification variant (0.01° tolerance) passes full 30-district integrity. 78 KB raw / 18.7 KB gzip is well within bundle budget. Enables district-level map browsing offline.
datasets.mobile_constraint: Attribution mandatory: geoBoundaries gbOpen IND ADM2 (CC BY 4.0).
datasets.g1_reclassification_reason: Stage F evaluated the raw 4.6 MB file. Stage G1 simplification reduces to 78 KB, enabling bundle inclusion.

datasets.rationale: District HQ hospitals, tourist police, emergency dispatch — stable reference identifiers and coordinates qualify for bundling. Mutable contact fields (phone, hours) constrained by cache policy.
datasets.mobile_constraint: Phone numbers and hours must display stale label if beyond freshness window. Live call routing must use real-time network fetch.

datasets.rationale: Operational facts (hours, fees, seasonal closures) are MUTABLE_CONTACT class. Do not bundle; fetch on destination detail load and cache with 7-day TTL.
datasets.mobile_constraint: Show stale label if cache is older than 7 days. Never infer closure from absence of data.

datasets.rationale: Media candidate metadata is a backend ingestion manifest, not consumer client runtime data. Actual media assets are not bundled. Server resolves license and CDN delivery.
datasets.mobile_constraint: Client never reads this manifest directly.

datasets.rationale: Statutory GI registrations change only via official CGPDTM gazette notifications. Highly stable. 2.4 KB gzip.
datasets.mobile_constraint: Preserve GI_PRODUCT semantic type; do not merge into generic Place records.

datasets.rationale: Craft village cluster coordinates and cooperative identifiers are stable cultural reference metadata. 1.8 KB gzip.
datasets.mobile_constraint: Preserve CRAFT_CLUSTER semantic type; do not transform into Place records.

datasets.rationale: GI-registered dishes and FSSAI hubs are official food reference records with low mutation rate. 1.4 KB gzip.
Government guesthouse and lodge contact details (phone, tariff, availability) are mutable. Fetch on accommodation search; cache with 24-hour TTL.
datasets.mobile_constraint: Tariff data always null until official rate tables ingested. Stale label required after 24 h.

datasets.rationale: Station codes (NTES), zone identifiers, and static coordinates change only via IRCTC official updates. 1.3 KB gzip.
datasets.mobile_constraint: No live schedule, platform, or delay data bundled. Static identity only.

datasets.rationale: 5 civil airports with IATA/ICAO codes, operator, and coordinates. Highly stable identity metadata. 1.1 KB gzip.
datasets.mobile_constraint: No live flight schedule, gate, or delay bundled. Static identity only.

datasets.rationale: IMD and NDMA SACHET are real-time alert providers. Warning content is always live. Bundle only provider URLs and API endpoint metadata.
datasets.mobile_constraint: Never display cached weather alerts as current. Always fetch fresh.

datasets.rationale: RAG corpus ingestion manifest. Backend pipeline artifact only.
